title: Kononenkogroup projects
description: Selected work on white: a grotesk heading with a small serif count, then project photos scattered across a 15-column grid in three sizes (wide, mid, tall) with staggered tops, each captioned with its name and a serif area; phones get stacked 8:5 cards. Cards rise a long way as they enter; on hover the photo swells to 1.035, the area slides up out of its slot and a 'view' link slides in and underlines itself after 0.3s.
notes: the scatter is designed for eight cards and repeats lower down for more
CSS only: the rise is scroll-driven; hover changes are transitions
name: kononenkogroup-projects

props.name: heading
props.description: the heading, one item per line on wide screens (one line on phones)

props.name: count
props.description: the small serif count after the heading, e.g. "(8+)"

props.name: visitLabel
props.description: the link that replaces the area on hover

props.name: more
props.description: the centred link under the grid

props.name: phoneCount
props.description: how many cards phones show (the original shows six); the rest appear from 1024px
